title: Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of Ezetimibe/Rosuvastatin and Candesartan Cilexetil/Amlodipine Besylate Combination Tablets

sections.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy and the safety of concomitant use of Ezetimibe/Rosuvastatin combination tablets and Candesartan cilexetil/Amlodipine besylate combination tablets compared to each combination tablet alone in patients with essential hypertension (HTN) and hyperlipidemia.
